Most fixtures in this directory are generated by tests/generate-format-fixtures.mjs from the existing tiny project fixtures. Archive samples contain the same synthetic GeoJSON.
sample.osm.pbf: GDAL upstream test fixture, https://github.com/OSGeo/gdal/blob/master/autotest/ogr/data/osm/test.pbf (GDAL MIT-style license: https://github.com/OSGeo/gdal/blob/master/LICENSE.TXT).
